text: Teaching Objectives To nurture qualified and skilled talents who are well-versed in Chinese language and culture, who will have a good grasp of knowledge in international trade, management, and finance as well as the experience in operating and handling real-life projects, especially those pertaining to Chinese economy, society, and who understand the Chinese culture values, so as to meet the demands of the fast changing world economy. International Faculty Group Most lecturers of the core & distinctive courses are fluent English-speaking lecturers recruited worldwide. All lecturers have practical experience in teaching and years of experience working in the industry. In addition, renowned scholars and practitioners will be invited to give lessons or lectures. Internship and Career Development In order to nurture students mastering the practical skills, our university have designed a variety of social and business activities for students. We also assists students in their career development through the Center of Professional Development Immersion Week One week of immersion week in every semester provides students with opportunities to be exposed to industry seminars, lectures given by professors and practitioners, business forums and competitions, field trips, case studies, and group business projects and presentations to further reinforce their business knowledge and practical skills. Degree Awarded Qualified student will be granted Master Degree of Economics Career Counseling Students will have the opportunities to be engaged in industrial collaborative projects, visits to companies, interview techniques, resume instructions and review, and career consultation. Future Career The university will help get employ chances in good companies and organizations.
